text: Lanterns have long been utilized to create awe-inspiring effects, particularly in the night sky. By suspending glass or plastic orbs filled with gas or oil, people have been able to project light paths into the darkness for centuries. These glowing trails, visible against the dark backdrop of the night, have been employed in various cultural and spiritual contexts, from religious festivals to festive celebrations. In modern times, they are most commonly associated with Halloween and lantern shows, where thousands of lights illuminate winding paths and structures, transforming the darkness into a magical spectacle. From historical lantern parades to contemporary city lights displays, these illuminated trails offer a timeless way to captivate and enchant audiences, turning the night into a living story.
